items.t: Engine burns oil from faulty piston rings
items.job: Replace pistons and rings (or the engine)
items.note: A full engine replacement can top $10,000. Ask Volvo about goodwill or class-action coverage first.

items.t: 12V battery drains and car won't start
items.note: A software update or service bulletin may fix the drain itself.

items.t: Vibration or shudder when braking
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Center screen stuck restarting (Google system)
items.job: Infotainment software reload at a dealer
items.note: Usually covered by Volvo's new-car warranty; the dealer applies the bulletin fix.

items.t: Check engine light for misfire fixed by software
items.job: Engine software update at a dealer
items.note: Usually covered by Volvo's new-car warranty; the dealer applies the bulletin fix.

items.t: Knocking from the rear electric motor (T8)
items.job: Install rear electric drive repair kit
items.note: Usually covered by Volvo's new-car warranty; the dealer applies the bulletin fix.

items.t: AWD angle gear grinding noise
items.note: One owner reports the part alone is about $2,000.

items.t: Audio module stops working
items.note: Owners report about $1,200 total.
